name: Dumbbell Seated Curl to Press
steps: Sit upright on a bench with feet planted and dumbbells hanging at your sides, palms forward.
Bend your elbows to curl both dumbbells smoothly to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms forward and press both dumbbells straight overhead until your arms extend.
Lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders and reverse the curl down to your sides.
tips: Keep your ribs down during the transition into the overhead press.
Avoid rocking your torso backward during either the curl or the press.
